mentions.name: TinyFish
mentions.description: Browser automation APIs built for AI agents. TinyFish provides structured browser primitives that agents can actually reason about — DOM state, element targeting, and action verification — so an agent knows whether an action succeeded rather than just that it clicked something, avoiding the fragile screenshot-and-click approach of typical agent frameworks. It is being used with a few enterprise teams on their agent pipelines.
mentions.problem: Most agent frameworks treat the browser like a human would (screenshot, click, pray), which breaks constantly and leaves agents without confirmation that their actions succeeded.
mentions.audience: Enterprise teams working on AI agent pipelines.
